title: Naturally Roasted Indian Chicken Kebabs
description: A juicy and flavorful Indian dish featuring roasted chicken, shallots, and render-fat, perfect for kids and adults alike, with a high protein content.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together ghee or oil, garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 20 minutes.
While the chicken is roasting, mix the chopped shallots with a pinch of salt and let it sit for 5 minutes to allow the shallots to soften.
After 20 minutes of roasting, brush the softened shallots onto the chicken pieces.
Return the skewers to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the oven and brush with lemon juice.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
